title: Three Bowls Down

pre.en: What does Chen's last bowl turn into?
pre.zh: 小陈的最后一个碗变成了什么？
options: Nothing — it falls off the wheel

intro: 陶艺课第一节，小陈和老师 Ruth 的对话：四十分钟弄塌了三个碗，Ruth 一个一个问原因。读的时候留意过去完成时和一般过去时搭配着用：先发生的原因用 had done（忘了把手沾湿），接着发生的结果用一般过去时（泥粘在手上）。

sentences.en: Right, Chen, that's three bowls down in forty minutes.
sentences.zh: 好了，小陈，四十分钟，报废三个碗了。
sentences.speaker: Ruth

sentences.en: So what happened to the first one?
sentences.zh: 说说吧，第一个是怎么回事？

sentences.en: Well, I'd been watching pottery videos all week — about thirty of them.
sentences.zh: 呃，我看了一整个星期的陶艺视频，差不多三十个。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: So I assumed I'd get a feel for the wheel in an hour.
sentences.zh: 所以我以为一个小时就能摸到拉坯机的门道。

sentences.en: But the first one collapsed before I'd even noticed I was pressing too hard.
sentences.zh: 结果我还没发现自己用力太猛，第一个就塌了。

sentences.en: Every beginner falls for those videos.
sentences.zh: 新手都会被那些视频骗。
sentences.speaker: Ruth

sentences.en: The people in them have been doing it for years.
sentences.zh: 视频里的人都做了好多年了。

sentences.en: And the second?
I hadn't centred the clay properly, so it wobbled and fell over.
sentences.zh: 我没把泥摆正，它晃来晃去就倒了。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: On the third one, I'd forgotten to wet my hands.
sentences.zh: 第三个，我忘了先把手沾湿。

sentences.en: The clay stuck to my fingers and came off the wheel.
sentences.zh: 泥全粘在手指上，从拉坯机上被带了下来。

sentences.en: Thirty videos, three bowls.
It doesn't add up.
Oh, it adds up perfectly.
sentences.speaker: Ruth

sentences.en: It's simple physics — videos don't have clay in them.
sentences.zh: 简单的物理而已——视频里又没有泥。

sentences.en: Look, you need to slow down.
If a bowl starts to wobble, don't hesitate to stop.
sentences.zh: 碗一开始晃，就别犹豫，马上停。

sentences.en: Don't try to save it.
Just leave it behind and start from scratch.
I'd never touched clay before I was forty-five, and my first bowls were much worse than yours.
sentences.zh: 我四十五岁之前连泥都没碰过，我做的头几个碗比你的差远了。

sentences.en: Practice makes perfect.
That's good to hear.
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: Tom says I've got too much time on my hands at weekends anyway.
sentences.zh: 反正 Tom 说我周末闲得发慌。

sentences.en: Maybe I should buy a wheel and practise at home.
sentences.zh: 要不我买台拉坯机，在家练？

sentences.en: Last year a student bought one after his first class.
sentences.zh: 去年有个学员上完第一节课就买了一台。
sentences.speaker: Ruth

sentences.en: He sold it on a month later.
Anyway, are you good with your hands?
I'm good with a keyboard.
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: Does that count?
Not really.
sentences.speaker: Ruth

sentences.en: It's ten to twelve, so have one last go.
sentences.zh: 现在十一点五十，最后再试一次吧。

sentences.en: And you'd better not snack on those biscuits with clay on your fingers.
sentences.zh: 还有，手上沾着泥，可别去拿那些饼干吃。

sentences.en: OK, I've finished.
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: Is it a bowl?
Hmm.
sentences.speaker: Ruth

sentences.en: Well done.
You've made a plate.

cards.zh: 摸到……的门道；找到……的感觉
cards.note: to start to understand how to do something or how something works
cards.tip: feel 在这里是名词，前面要有 a；也可以说 have a feel for sth（已经有感觉了，说状态）。
cards.example: It took me a few weeks to get a feel for the new city.

cards.note: 楼、桥、人都能 collapse；名词也是 collapse。

cards.zh: 上（某种花招）的当；信以为真
cards.note: to be tricked into believing something that is not true
cards.tip: fall for sb 还有「爱上某人」的意思；fall 的过去式 fell、过去分词 fallen。
cards.example: I can't believe I fell for that old trick again.

cards.note: 做陶的专门说法：把泥在转盘正中压稳。英式拼写 centre，美式 center。
不可数：a piece of clay、a lump of clay。
桌子腿不平也会 wobble；形容词 wobbly。
wet 的过去式、过去分词常和原形一样：wet；也可以是 wetted。
if numbers or facts do not add up, they do not make sense or seem wrong
cards.tip: 这里用的是引申义「合乎情理」，多用在否定句里：It doesn't add up.
cards.example: His story doesn't add up — he says he was at home, but his car was at the station.

cards.note: to do something less quickly, or to become less busy
cards.tip: 可以不带宾语：You need to slow down；也可以带：slow the car down。反义 speed up。
cards.example: Slow down — I can't understand you when you talk so fast.

cards.note: used to tell someone they should feel free to do something
to forget to take something with you when you leave a place
to begin something again from the very beginning, without using anything from before
cards.tip: from scratch（第 39 课）也能跟别的动词：build sth from scratch、cook from scratch。
cards.example: The file was lost, so we had to start from scratch.

cards.note: if you do something again and again, you will become very good at it
cards.tip: 英式拼写里 practice 是名词，practise 是动词，这句谚语里用名词 practice。
cards.example: My piano playing is still terrible, but practice makes perfect.

cards.zh: 闲着没事；有大把空闲时间
cards.note: to have a lot of free time and not much to do
to sell something that you bought earlier to another person
cards.tip: 代词放中间：sell it on；名词可以放后面：sell on the tickets。
cards.example: He bought the bike for £300 and sold it on for £250.

cards.note: to be skilful at making or repairing things
cards.tip: your 跟着人称变：good with his hands；good with people 是「会跟人打交道」，good with numbers 是「对数字在行」。
cards.example: My grandad was very good with his hands — he built our kitchen table.

cards.note: 这里不是「数数」，而是「被算进去」：That doesn't count.（那不算。）
to try to do something, often for the first time
cards.tip: 英式口语；go 是名词，可以说 one more go、one last go；试着做某事用 have a go at doing sth。
cards.example: I've never played golf, but I'd love to have a go.

cards.note: to eat small amounts of a particular food between meals
